exposure.needed: whether the environment's dashboards, alert rules or other metric consumers reference the old metric name envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected

original.statement: The Cilium 1.17 upgrade notes (Changed Metrics) state that the metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`.

decision.reason: [ev-f7021b9d3606] and [ev-77f05428497a] only say that the NPDS metric prefix changed from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_` to `envoy_cilium_npds_`. No Helm value, flag, field or other setting is named that would decide exposure. An environment is exposed only if something outside the product's configuration uses the old name, such as dashboards, alert rules or queries. No Cilium configuration predicate can read that, and the evidence states no condition, so an undecidable leaf with evidence-gap that names this need is the right exposure.
